description: Source-lore pass 10 indexes the Airship Engineer, Air Captain, and Sky Warden class concepts and their specialization paths as legacy mechanics requiring conversion.

entries.title: Airship Engineer
entries.summary: Airship Engineers are mechanical innovators who repair and enhance vessels, construct gadgets, improve weapons, deploy defenses, and create traps.
body: The Airship Engineer fills a vital crew role in Kaysender. Engineers keep [[airships|airships]] operational, diagnose failing components, reinforce hulls, improve engines and weapons, and improvise tactical devices when normal equipment is insufficient.

Their three principal paths are the [[ship-engineer-archetype|Ship Engineer]], focused on repair and vessel enhancement; the [[sky-machine-engineer-archetype|Sky Machine Engineer]], focused on combat gadgets and mechanical defenses; and the [[tinker-engineer-archetype|Tinker Engineer]], focused on rapid construction and traps.
The class is built around craftsmanship, tactical support, innovation, and the ability to turn tools and preparation into battlefield or voyage advantages.

sections.heading: Legacy Mechanics Index
body: The source supplies a complete levels 1-5 progression with hit points, proficiencies, Tinker's Expertise, Engineer's Ingenuity, gadgets, archetype selection, ability improvement, prototype devices, class tables, and detailed numerical abilities.
Example gadgets include emergency grappling hooks, repair drones, smoke bombs, boosters, repulsion fields, static discharge arrays, turrets, shields, and traps. All require Hypertext d20 conversion.

entries.title: Ship Engineer Archetype
entries.summary: Ship Engineers specialize in hull fortification, rapid repair, engine overdrive, structural reinforcement, repair crews, and mastery of engines.
body: Ship Engineers concentrate on keeping vessels alive and improving their performance. Their source progression moves from hull reinforcement and quick repairs to machine mastery, engine overdrive, damage resistance, coordinated repair crews, and advanced engine work.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: The complete levels 1-5 numerical progression is preserved in the source chunk and remains mechanics-legacy pending conversion.

entries.title: Sky Machine Engineer Archetype
entries.summary: Sky Machine Engineers specialize in deployable turrets, enhanced weapons, rapid rebuilding, automated defenders, shielding, and overclocked devices.
body: Sky Machine Engineers turn mechanical expertise toward combat. Their path covers tool mastery, deployable defenses, elemental weapon modifications, emergency rebuilding, automated defenders, mechanical shielding, overclocking, and secondary effects such as stunning or forced movement.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: The complete levels 1-5 numerical progression is mechanics-legacy pending conversion.

entries.title: Tinker Engineer Archetype
entries.summary: Tinker Engineers specialize in fast crafting, utility gadgets, repairs, explosive and disabling traps, and advanced one-off creations.
body: Tinker Engineers emphasize improvisation and trapmaking. Their path develops from artisan tools and simple traps into rapid repairs, smoke bombs, grappling devices, advanced explosive or disabling traps, and master creations such as companions or traversal devices.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: The complete levels 1-5 numerical progression is mechanics-legacy pending conversion.

entries.title: Air Captain
entries.summary: Air Captains are charismatic leaders, navigators, and tacticians who command crews, improve morale, and direct critical combat and exploration decisions.
body: Air Captains command vessels and crews through dangerous skies. Their role combines route planning, ship management, tactical orders, morale, exploration, and decisive leadership under pressure.

The class branches into the [[sky-warlord-archetype|Sky Warlord]] for battlefield command, the [[explorer-captain-archetype|Explorer Captain]] for navigation and discovery, and the [[shipwright-captain-archetype|Shipwright Captain]] for construction and repair.
Captains complement [[airship-engineer-class|Engineers]] and [[sky-warden-class|Sky Wardens]] by deciding where the crew goes, how it responds, and when individual skills become coordinated action.

sections.heading: Legacy Mechanics Index
body: The source provides levels 1-5 hit points, proficiencies, tactical orders, inspiring command, movement abilities, archetype selection, master tactics, a class table, and a gadget chart. All numerical rules require conversion.

entries.title: Sky Warlord Archetype
entries.summary: Sky Warlords direct allies through tactical orders, inspiration, coordinated retreats, extra strikes, and battlefield resolve.
body: Sky Warlords are battle commanders. Their source path emphasizes chosen combat tactics, protection through inspiration, immediate repositioning, coordinated retreat, amplified allied attacks, and group endurance.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: The levels 1-5 mechanics remain legacy material pending conversion.

entries.title: Explorer Captain Archetype
entries.summary: Explorer Captains specialize in route planning, navigation, scouting, mapping, hazard knowledge, courage, and resource discovery.
body: Explorer Captains lead expeditions into unfamiliar skies. Their source path improves route planning, weather forecasting, survival, mapping, resistance to fear and exhaustion, recall of known regions, pathfinding, and the discovery of useful supplies or treasure.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: The levels 1-5 mechanics remain legacy material pending conversion.

entries.title: Shipwright Captain Archetype
entries.summary: Shipwright Captains combine command with vessel construction, mechanical inspection, reinforcement, emergency repair, and equipment improvement.
body: Shipwright Captains understand command through construction. Their source path covers shipwright tools, inspection for weaknesses, hull reinforcement, active repairs, precision devices, emergency fixes, and major equipment upgrades.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: The levels 1-5 mechanics remain legacy material pending conversion.

entries.title: Sky Warden
entries.summary: Sky Wardens are divine protectors who prevent catastrophic falls, heal crews, ward allies, and answer aerial threats through wind, aether, or storm power.
body: Sky Wardens protect people from the defining dangers of Kaysender's skies. They combine healing, defensive support, fall prevention, morale, and divine power, making them especially valuable when a single failed line or broken rail could send a crew member into the abyss.

Their domains are the [[zephyr-domain|Zephyr Domain]], centered on wind and speed; the [[aether-domain|Aether Domain]], centered on magical protection and healing; and the [[stormcall-domain|Stormcall Domain]], centered on thunder, lightning, and aggressive defense.
The class concept directly complements [[fall-prevention-gear|mundane and magical safety equipment]] by making rescue and aerial protection a sacred vocation.

sections.heading: Legacy Mechanics Index
body: The source provides a levels 1-5 progression with hit points, proficiencies, Abyssal Anchor, Sky's Blessing, divine channeling, domain selection, a protective dome, temporary flight, a class table, and a gadget chart. All numerical rules require conversion.

entries.title: Zephyr Domain
entries.summary: The Zephyr Domain develops windborne movement, gale attacks, fall protection, windwalking, and typhoon power.
body: Zephyr Sky Wardens turn divine protection into movement. Their source progression runs through Windborn Blessing, Gale Strikes, Zephyr's Embrace, Windwalk, and Typhoon's Fury.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: All levels 1-5 effects remain mechanics-legacy pending conversion.

entries.title: Aether Domain
entries.summary: The Aether Domain develops healing, magical shielding, celestial wards, protective aether, and ascension.
body: Aether Sky Wardens emphasize magical protection and healing. Their source progression runs through Aetheric Blessing, Aether Shield, Celestial Ward, Protective Aether, and Celestial Ascension.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: All levels 1-5 effects remain mechanics-legacy pending conversion.

entries.title: Stormcall Domain
entries.summary: The Stormcall Domain combines protection with thunder, lightning, storm auras, rapid movement, and overwhelming storm power.
body: Stormcall Sky Wardens weaponize the weather while defending allies. Their source progression runs through Thunderous Blessing, Call of the Storm, Thunderclap Aura, Lightning Stride, and Stormlord's Wrath.

sections.heading: Conversion Status
body: All levels 1-5 effects remain mechanics-legacy pending conversion.
